annotation_rule: CHM13 RefSeq Liftoff v5.3: exact gene symbol, unique gene feature on primary chromosomes. Duplicate/missing loci held. GFF 1-based inclusive converted to 0-based half-open. Gene boundary TSS, not inferred dominant isoform. hg19 refGene: same-symbol transcripts on one primary chromosome/strand use outer gene boundary TSS; discordant loci held.
signal_rule: Exact overlap-length-weighted BigWig records. Report integral/window length (uncovered bases zero-filled) and covered fraction separately. Missing chromosome is an error. A mark/H3 ratio is computed only when both tracks cover >=80% of window and both means are strictly positive; no pseudocount. No cross-mark absolute comparison, no global modification claim, no p-values. CPM profiles, not spike-in scaled occupancy.
contrast_rule: Log2 mark/H3 ratio difference for each matched CUT label; report both labels and direction concordance, not population inference. H3 comes from matched state/CUT in GSE289683; mark coverage and H3 effects remain visible.
methylation_rule: Single-donor D0/D4/D6 normal differentiation reference. Intersect hg19 promoter windows with author UMR/LMR and PMD domain calls. Report fraction of window covered by each class. No CpG methylation estimate, DMR p-value, or transition-state assignment inferred from domain overlap.
pats_rule: Quantitative between-condition comparison requires verified deposited-track normalization and compatible controls. If unresolved, hold the comparison rather than comparing raw peak abundance. File acquisition cap 256 MiB remains in force.
